synonyms: Las historias de fantasmas de Mimi
synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? title: Yumemiru Renaissance
titleNative: 夢見るルネサンス
synopsis: Licia, born in Florence in the 16th Century, wanted to become a Moe art illustrator! A girl who dreams of becoming a painter, Licia, falls from the sky in front of the slightly otaku girl, Ren! Claiming that she came from Florence in the 16th century, Licia decided to pursue the path of moe-art after seeing the anime poster in Ren's room. This is the story of the dream and friendship of a painter girl who transcends countries and eras!
